existingGaps.original: Original reconstruction document §2 suggests one fixed bottom player footer on all pages.
existingGaps.current: App.ShowGame hides the global 52px footer; in-game GameHud displays player information.

existingGaps.original: Original reconstruction document §§15–17 describes the complete action/dialog/player-facing log/settlement experience.
existingGaps.current: Current normal GameScreen mainly integrates server map, player HUD and refresh/retry. Full action/log/settlement UI is not comprehensively implemented or accepted by this art archive.
existingGaps.scope: Existing frontend feature scope gap; no claim of complete online gameplay acceptance.

existingGaps.original: Some early documents describe owner-start and an older room flow.
existingGaps.current: README explicitly makes ES完整API文档.md, API接口清单.md and current protocol implementation authoritative for ready/selection/automatic start; do not restore a removed endpoint to satisfy an older example.

scope: Archive format/resources and art-delta compatibility review, not complete frontend functional/online acceptance. No repository-wide formatter/editorconfig is defined; no invented style rule or bulk code rewrite applied.
